notes.title: Update 1.32
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug where selecting the Ninja would incorrectly start the game with the Mage's book.
- Updated some tutorial instructions to reflect the chosen class when selecting either the Ninja or the Mage.
- Now, whenever the player returns to the village, health and energy are fully restored, but hunger remains.
- Corrected the level-up message text for the Ninja and Mage classes.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 1.25
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug where the last row of the inventory did not display the correct item values.
-The time it takes to move the camera when looking downward has been halved.
- In the village defense stage, talking to the village leader now pauses the game, giving players time to read the tips.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 1.24
notes.content: Added new recipes to the "Recipes" menu.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 1.23
notes.content:
🔧 Bug Fix
Fixed an issue where the volume settings were not being saved properly, causing audio preferences to reset after restarting the game.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 1.22
notes.content:
🗨️ Updated Dwarf NPC Dialogue:
The first dialogue of the dwarf NPC has been changed. He now warns players about the difficulty of the area, especially for low-level characters.

🖥️ Resolution Settings Added:
It is now possible to change the monitor resolution from the settings menu to better adjust the game to different screens.

🧍‍♂️ New NPC in the Village:
A new NPC has been added to the village. While he doesn’t offer missions yet, he will eventually unlock access to new areas for the player.

🏹 Archer Mercenary Behavior Update:
Archer mercenaries following the player will now automatically attack when the player initiates combat.

🏴‍☠️ New Coral Sea Event:
The first time the player visits the Coral Sea, they will discover a chest containing a ballista, allowing them to explore the region more effectively.

notes.title: New Zone: Dwarven Caves
notes.content:
A brand-new underground area full of challenges.

The cave consists of 6 portals, each leading to 5 sub-levels and a zone boss.

New Equipment: Battle Axes

Not only powerful in combat but can also be used to mine and chop wood.

New Resources: Gems

Dropped by monsters in the Dwarven Caves.

Can be used to acquire battle axes and other special items.

Storage Capacity Improvements

Player inventory expanded to hold more items.

Village storage chest now holds more items, making organization easier.

Quality of Life Improvements

Items can now be equipped or unequipped with a single right-click.

notes.title: Gameplay Adjustments:
notes.content:
- The player no longer receives knockback when hitting plants and mushrooms.

- Melee weapons can now hit multiple enemies simultaneously. However, the damage is reduced by 2 points for each subsequent enemy hit in the same attack.

notes.title: Texture improvement
notes.content:
- Changed the texture of the Mushroom Tree and Pine Trees.
- The background texture of the cave stage has been changed.

notes.title: Gameplay Adjustments
notes.content:
Scroll Wheel Behavior Change:

We’ve heard feedback from our community regarding the way the scroll wheel works for the main toolbar. Players pointed out that in most other games, scrolling up moves left, and scrolling down moves right.

To align with this familiar standard, we’ve adjusted the scroll wheel behavior:

Scroll up: Moves left.
Scroll down: Moves right.

notes.title: Combat and Balance Update
notes.content:
[b]Combat and Balance Update[/b]

- The combat system has been improved! Now, when hitting an enemy with the sword, both the player and the enemy are pushed in opposite directions, providing a stronger sense of impact and a more dynamic combat experience.

- A subtle screen shake effect has been added when hitting enemies, enhancing the feeling of impact.
This same knockback effect also applies to your hired mercenaries.

- When the player is hit by enemies, both the player and the enemies are pushed back in opposite directions, maintaining consistency in the combat mechanics.

[b]Precision and Impact Improvements[/b]

- The hitboxes of all weapons have been adjusted, fixing instances where attacks failed to register hits on enemies even when visually connecting.

- The knockback of creatures has been rebalanced, reducing excessive pushback for a more natural and fair impact.

[b]New Movement and Mounted Combat Features[/b]

- Players can now attack while moving when using melee weapons.
While mounted on a horse, the player can also attack while moving, using both the bow and melee weapons, increasing combat versatility.

[b]Mercenary Balance Adjustments[/b]

-The fighter mercenary's health has been increased from 120 to 200.

-The archer mercenary's health has been increased from 25 to 40.

notes.title: Game Update
notes.content:
New Content:

Added new achievements for the new character's new missions.

Bug Fixes:

Fixed some positioning bugs in the Thorn Jungle level.

Fixed the weight of the acid that sank the ship.

notes.title: Major Update
notes.content:
A new NPC has arrived in the Village! He can take you to unique and mysterious locations for a fee of gold per trip.

Exclusive Treasures:

Each location offers exclusive challenges and unique rewards.

Upon reaching the end of each special scenario, players will find theses treasures.

notes.title: Combat Update
notes.content:
Hitbox Improvement:

The hitbox for all weapons has been adjusted, now covering a larger area, allowing attacks to hit targets slightly above the character's head.

New Knockback Effect:

When taking damage, creatures will now experience a knockback effect, being pushed back based on the strength of the attack received. This adjustment enhances the visual impact and dynamics of combat.

notes.title: Small adjustments
notes.content:
The hit-stop effect has been adjusted to trigger only on critical damage. Previously, when multiple hits occurred in quick succession, it gave the impression that the game was lagging, which negatively impacted the gameplay experience rather than enhancing it.

In the first level of the campaign mode, in the tutorial forest, we've added a hatchet. This change was necessary after some players reported the possibility of running out of sticks and having no hatchet to gather more. A box containing potions and meat was also added. The potions were included to assist players who found the early stages of the game too challenging.

The potion box has also been added at the beginning of survival mode.

notes.title: Quick Transfer & Village Chicken
notes.content:
New Feature:
You can now quickly transfer a stack of items between inventories by holding the Shift key and left-clicking on the item.

If there’s an empty slot available in the target inventory, the entire stack will move instantly, making inventory management faster and more efficient!

Village Addition:
A chicken has been added to the village in Campaign Mode to help those struggling with hunger. 🐔

notes.title: Steam Achievements have been added.
notes.content: Players will now be able to unlock Steam achievements. If you had already completed the goal before this date, you will need to complete it again to unlock it.

notes.title: Joystick Error Fixes
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where it was not possible to navigate between the inventory and the chest using joysticks.
Fixed an issue where it was not possible to activate the recipe list with joysticks.
Fixed an issue where the joystick settings were not saved for the blonde-haired player.

notes.title: "hit stop" effect
notes.content: Added "hit stop" effect. It is a brief pause or screen freeze that occurs when an attack hits a target. This pause, which lasts only fractions of a second, is used to enhance the visual impact and the sense of power of an attack.

notes.title: Small improvements
notes.content:
- Added an option in the settings for the camera to follow the mouse cursor.
- Now when you pick up arrows that are the same type as those in the quiver, they go directly into the quiver.
- Fixed a bug when scrolling the mouse wheel with two players active.

notes.title: small fixes
notes.content:
- Correction of the translation for the name of the bone arrow.
- In survival mode, equipment is now obtained at the beginning of stage 0 in the district.

notes.title: Small improvements
notes.content:
- When taking damage, the player was previously stunned for 1 second. In response to community feedback, the player can now react immediately after taking damage, allowing for quicker escapes from dangerous situations.
- The stone arrow recipe now produces two arrows, while arrows made from other metals yield three arrows. 
- Added a new arrow made from bone, but this recipe yields only one arrow.
- Fixed the image for the stone shield.
- Players can now kick to deal minimal damage when unarmed.
- You can now craft the maximum number of items possible by right-clicking to remove the crafted item.

notes.title: Small changes
notes.content:
Added an option in the settings for the player to look at the mouse cursor.
The range of the axe and pickaxe has been increased.

notes.title: Crafting recipes
notes.content: Some people were having difficulty saving recipes, so an option was added when pressing ESC where players can access the game's main recipes.

notes.title: Controls update
notes.content: The game was configured to start with the gamepad, which meant that people using the keyboard and mouse could not move. But it was reconfigured to start the default configuration with the keyboard.
